description: This file declares the D3D11H265Accelerator class, which implements H265 decoding acceleration using Direct3D 11 on Windows. It includes structures and methods for handling HEVC/H.265 video decoding, including picture parameter setup, slice submission, and decoding control.

classes.name: D3D11H265Accelerator
classes.description: A class implementing HEVC/H.265 video decoding acceleration using Direct3D 11 on Windows, managing picture parameters, slice submission, and decoding process.

methods.name: CreateH265Picture
methods.description: Creates a new H265 picture object.

methods.name: SubmitFrameMetadata
methods.description: Submits frame-level metadata including SPS, PPS, and slice header info.

methods.name: SubmitSlice
methods.description: Submits a slice of video data for decoding.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Initiates decoding of a submitted picture.

methods.name: IsChromaSamplingSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific chroma sampling format is supported.
